disputes_what.name: disputes_what
disputes_what.value: ("disputes"."kind" = 'payment' and "disputes"."payment_id" is not null and "disputes"."week" is null) or ("disputes"."kind" = 'rent' and "disputes"."payment_id" is null and "disputes"."week" is not null)

withdrawals_sent_has_hash.name: withdrawals_sent_has_hash
withdrawals_sent_has_hash.value: "withdrawals"."status" not in ('broadcast', 'paid', 'reverted') or ("withdrawals"."tx_hash" is not null and "withdrawals"."nonce" is not null)
